privacy: Your workbook stays in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.
invalid: Choose a readable Numbers workbook. The file may be damaged or use an unsupported archive layout.
protected: Password-encrypted Numbers files cannot be converted. Save an unencrypted copy and try again.
unsupported: This Numbers file uses an unsupported version or feature. Export it from Numbers as XLSX and try the Spreadsheet Viewer.
resource: This workbook needs more memory than this browser can provide. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The converter could not load. Check your connection and try again.
empty: This worksheet has no stored cell data.
previewNote: This window shows up to 20 rows and 8 columns. The download includes all imported tables and cells.
invalidAddress: Enter a cell address within this worksheet’s used range, such as A1.
missingCaches: Some formulas have no saved result. Their cells remain blank in the XLSX file; formula expressions are not exported.
preserved: Each Numbers table becomes a separate Excel worksheet. Text, numbers, booleans, dates, saved formula results, and supported merged cells are included. Original sheet and table names are listed below.
limitations: Formulas become their saved values; formula expressions are not retained or recalculated. Charts, images, text boxes, table placement, and styling are not preserved. Error cells use a generic spreadsheet error. Check the output before relying on it.
previewLimits: The preview shows imported cell data. Date values retain their date and time; durations are stored as numbers of days. Supported number formats may differ from Numbers.
mappingNote: Each source table maps to one Excel worksheet. Names are shortened or adjusted where Excel requires it.
